items.text: Hello everyone!

With the full game launching tomorrow, September 29th, 2026, we took the opportunity to make another round of adjustments, balance improvements, quality-of-life changes, and bug fixes based on your feedback.
Enemy Balance: We made balance adjustments to several enemies to make combat more consistent.

Desperation Move: The Desperation Move proved to be too powerful when consuming only one bar of mana, allowing players to escape difficult situations with very little downside. Because of this, it now consumes all of the player’s remaining mana, making its use a more strategic decision.
Arthur’s Dodge Cancel Window: We adjusted Arthur’s dodge cancel window to be more permissive.
S Rank: The requirements for achieving an S Rank in the stages have been adjusted.

Screen Shake: Various environmental objects and collectible items now react to screen shake, adding more impact and visual feedback to actions during gameplay. Additionally, there are now more moments throughout the game where the player’s controller will vibrate.

Game Name: We removed the “&” character from the game’s executable name and related directories. On some systems configured for certain languages, this character was not recognized correctly, which could prevent the game from launching.
Tutorial and Game Manual: We updated the tutorial and game manual to reflect the changes made and added some additional information.
Several minor reported bugs have also been fixed.
A
ttention: Due to the change in the game's path caused by the “&” character, it may be necessary to uninstall and reinstall the entire game on machines affected by this issue.
We want to thank everyone who played the DEMO and took the time to send us feedback.
Your feedback helped us identify areas that needed adjustments and directly contributed to improving the game experience.

And even with the full game launching tomorrow, September 29th, 2026, our work doesn’t end here. We’ll continue collecting feedback from the community after launch and will work on future updates to keep improving the game.
See you tomorrow.

releases.displayName: Major DEMO Update: Revamped Stages, Brand New Boss, and Combat Overhaul! ⚔️

items.text: Hello, Fighters!

We have a massive update for Blades & Battles DEMO! Based on player feedback, we've made numerous improvements across gameplay, visuals, and core mechanics. These changes aim to deliver a smoother, more balanced, and more enjoyable experience throughout the game.

New Tutorial Stage: A new interactive tutorial has been added to teach the basic mechanics and systems of the game. But don't be fooled—there are still hidden attacks and advanced techniques waiting to be discovered beyond the tutorial!

Stage 1 Remastered: The very first stage of the game has received a complete visual and mechanical overhaul. Backgrounds now feature more animations, enemies has new entrance sequences, and we've polished minor collision issues.
Brand New Stage & Boss: We have completely replaced the stage from our last demo! Explore a brand-new environment and prepare yourself to face a dangerous new boss waiting for you at the end.
Wake-Up Invulnerability: To prevent unfair chain attacks, players are now invulnerable for 10 frames immediately after recovering from a knockdown.

Desperation Attack Rework: Activating your desperation attack while taking damage now triggers a purple special move that pushes enemies away. While this mechanic existed before, it now features a distinct visual feedback, alongside with a brand-new aerial version.
Smarter Enemy AI: Behavior has been tuned across the board. Enemies will wander off-screen much less, some now possess dedicated anti-air counters, and aggressiveness is better balanced.
Clearer Attack Telegraphing: Minor enemies now have more anticipation frames on specific attacks, giving you a fairer window to react.

New Boss Stun Mechanic: The Stage 1 "Tank" boss (who is immune to knockdowns and hit stun) now has a Stun Meter. Hitting the boss fills a stun icon above his head; once completely filled, the boss is temporarily stunned and left completely vulnerable for a few seconds.
Boss Telegraphes: The Stage 1 boss now has more noticeable anticipation on his moves, both in terms of timing and added visual effects.
Area of Effect (AoE) Indicator: A brand-new visual feedback system has been added to large-scale enemy attacks so you can easily spot and avoid area damage.
Trigger Button Fix: Controller trigger buttons now function properly. By default, the trigger is mapped to picking up items, but you can fully rebind it in the "Options" menu.
Visual Filters: Customize your experience! You can now change the game's visual style in the "Options" menu by choosing between Pixelated, Super Pixelated, or No Pixelation (smooth).
Thank you all for the incredible support and feedback. Dive back in, master the new mechanics, and let us know what you think!
— QUByte Team
